title: Collect a colour palette
text: Find three different colours without picking anything. Give each one a name you would put on a paint tin.
keywords: colours color art creative photography visual flowers plants

title: Draw a sound map
text: Stay in a safe spot. Notice one sound nearby, one far away, and one in between. Remember where each came from.
keywords: quiet listen listening birds sound calm mindful peaceful relax

title: Give a cloud a story
text: Look at the sky without looking at the sun. If there are clouds, choose a shape and invent a one-sentence story. On a clear day, use a rooftop silhouette instead.
keywords: imagination children family story clouds sky playful

title: Find a tiny world
text: From a path or seat, look for a small patch of moss, a crack, or a leaf. Notice three details you would usually miss. Leave it untouched.
keywords: small detail texture moss leaf nature curious close observation

title: Spot the invisible wind
text: Find something the breeze moves: a leaf, a flag, or a cloud. Watch its rhythm for a moment. If the air is still, notice what is completely motionless.
keywords: wind breeze weather movement mindful slow calm

title: Hunt for a repeating pattern
text: Look for a pattern in bark, paving, a fence, or a leaf. Count five repeats, then look for the tiny difference that breaks the pattern.
keywords: patterns geometry math shapes bark paving architecture curious

title: Trace a shadow in your mind
text: Choose a shadow and follow its outline with your eyes. What changes if you look at the empty space around it? If there are no shadows, try a silhouette.
keywords: shadow light sunshine photography visual art shapes

title: Compose a word postcard
text: Pick a view and remember three words for it: one colour, one sound, one feeling. No photo needed. Repeat your postcard once before you leave.
keywords: writing poetry words memory creative mindful view

title: Listen for a bird conversation
text: Listen without moving closer to wildlife. Can you hear a repeated call and an answer? No birds today? Listen for two other sounds that seem to reply to each other.
keywords: birds birdwatching birdsong chirping listening wildlife nature

title: Meet three leaf shapes
text: Observe leaves still attached to plants. Find a smooth edge, a pointed edge, and a shape that surprises you. You do not need to know the plant names.
keywords: leaves plants botany trees garden green shapes nature

title: Find green in an unexpected place
text: Look from the pavement for a plant growing beside a wall or between stones. Notice how much room it has found. Stay on the path and leave it where it is.
keywords: city urban street weeds plant resilient nature cracks pavement

title: Hear the street's rhythm
text: Stop somewhere safely away from traffic. Find a steady sound and an irregular sound. Tap their rhythms silently with your fingers.
keywords: city urban street music sounds rhythm listening

title: Pitch a very small wonder
text: Choose something ordinary in view. Imagine a ten-second advert explaining why it is extraordinary. Share it with a companion, or say it quietly to yourself.
keywords: fun family children imagination game playful creative story

title: Watch one minute of movement
text: Choose leaves, grass, or a distant bird and watch from where you are. Notice the smallest movement. Do not follow or disturb animals.
keywords: relax calm slow mindfulness stress peace nature movement wildlife

title: Make a portrait of a tree
text: Choose a tree you can see comfortably. Notice its outline, a branch, and its bark. Remember those three features as if you were going to draw it later.
keywords: tree forest woodland bark drawing sketch art nature

title: Listen beyond your little patch
text: From a safe outdoor seat or balcony, hear what lies beyond your view. Name three sound layers. Keep your eyes open if you need them for balance or orientation.
keywords: balcony small space seated restful calm listen sounds relax

title: Find three characters
text: Choose three visible shapes: perhaps a stone, a cloud, and a branch. Give them names and imagine how they met. Leave every object in place.
keywords: children family kids story imagination creative playful games

title: Notice what changes
text: Choose a small view and take a slow mental snapshot. Watch it for a few minutes. What moved, appeared, or became noticeable? There is no score to beat.
keywords: mindfulness peaceful rest relaxing quiet patient observation movement
